% adjustbox given pdfTeX's driver option beside export, which it passes to
% graphicx and trimclip, then graphicx and trimclip loaded again with the
% option, which is no clash; with hyperref. \clipbox, \adjustbox's trim
% and clip, and \trimbox, in a paragraph, in a footnote, and in a theorem;
% a picture trimmed and clipped by \includegraphics and by \adjustbox.
% Each box is as without the option, where trimclip uses its dvips driver.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[pdftex,export]{adjustbox}
\usepackage[pdftex]{graphicx}
\usepackage[pdftex]{trimclip}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{Boxes}\label{boxes}

Clip: \clipbox{1pt 0pt 1pt 0pt}{clipped text}. After the clip.

Adjust: \adjustbox{trim=0pt,clip}{adjusted text}. After the adjustment.

Trim: \trimbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{trimmed text}. After the trim.

Picture: \includegraphics[trim=1pt 1pt 1pt 1pt,clip,width=1cm]{test-picture.png}.
After the picture.

Boxed picture: \adjustbox{trim=1pt 0pt 1pt 0pt,clip}{\includegraphics[width=1cm]{test-picture.png}}.
After the boxed picture.

A note.\footnote{Note: \clipbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{noted clip}. After the
note's clip.}

\begin{theorem}
Theorem: \trimbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{theorem trim}. See
section~\ref{boxes}.
\end{theorem}
\end{document}
